1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi. Ni indirimbo ya Dawidi yitwa Zaburi.

2.text: Imana izahaguruka abanzi bayo batatane,Kandi abayanga bazahunga mu maso hayo.

3.text: Nk'uko umwotsi utumuka ni ko uzabatumura,Nk'uko ibimamara biyagira imbere y'umuriro,Ni ko abanyamahanga bazarimbukira imbere y'Imana.

4.text: Ariko abakiranutsi bazanezerwa,Bazishimira imbere y'Imana,Ni koko bazishima ibyishimo.

5.text: Nimuririmbire Imana, muririmbire izina ryawe ishimweMuharurire Imana inzira inyura mu butayu, iri mu igare,Izina ryayo ni YA, mwishimire imbere yayo.

6.text: Imana iri mu buturo bwayo bwera,Ni se w'impfubyi n'umucamanza urengera abapfakazi.

7.text: Imana ibesha mu mazu abatagira shinge na rugero,Ibohora imbohe ikaziha kugubwa neza,Ariko abagome bakaba mu gihugu gikakaye.

8.text: Mana, ubwo wajyaga imbere y'ubwoko bwawe,Ubwo wagendaga mu butayu,Sela.

9.text: Isi yahinze igishyitsi,Ijuru riyengera imbere y'Imana,Sinayi iriya ihindira igishyitsi imbere y'Imana,Ni yo Mana y'Abisirayeli.

10.text: Mana, wavubiye imvura y'ubuntu umwandu wawe,Wawushubijemo intege ubwo wari urushye.

11.text: Ubwoko bwawe bwatuye muri wo,Mana witeguriye umunyamubabaro,Ku bwo kugira neza kwawe.

12.text: Umwami Imana yatanze itegeko,Abagore bamamaza inkuru baba benshi.

13.text: Abami bagaba ingabo barahunga, barahunga,Umugore usigaye mu rugo ni we ugabanya iminyago.

14.text: Mukiryama mu ngo z'intama,Amababa y'inuma akengeranaho ifeza,N'amoya yayo akengeranaho izahabu y'amazi.

15.text: Ubwo Ishoborabyose yatatanirizaga abami mu gihugu,Shelegi yagwaga kuri Salumoni.

16.text: Umusozi w'i Bashani ni umusozi w'Imana,Umusozi w'i Bashani ni umusozi w'impinga nyinshi.

17.text: Mwa misozi y'impinga nyinshi mwe,Ni iki gituma murebana ishyari,Umusozi Imana yashatse kubaho?Ni koko, Uwiteka azawubaho iteka ryose.

18.text: Amagare y'Imana abarika inzovu ebyiri, inzovu ebyiri,Ni koko, ni ibihumbi n'ibihumbi,Umwami Imana iri hagati yayo,Sinayi iri ahera ho mu rusengero.

19.text: Urazamutse ujya hejuru ujyanye iminyago,Uhērewe impano hagati y'abantu,Ni koko, uziherewe hagati y'abagome na bo,Kugira ngo Uwiteka Imana ibane na bo.

20.text: Umwami ahimbazwe utwikorerera umutwaro uko bukeye,Ni we Mana itubera agakiza.Sela.

21.text: Imana itubera Imana y'agakiza idukiza kenshi,Kandi Uwiteka Umwami ni we ubasha gukūra mu rupfu.

22.text: Ariko Imana izamenagura imitwe y'abanzi bayo,N'igikoba kiriho umusatsi cy'umuntu wese ukomeza kwishyiraho urubanza.

23.text: Umwami Imana yaravuze iti“Nzabagarura bave i Bashani,Nzabagarura bave imuhengeri w'inyanja,

24.text: Kugira ngo winike ikirenge cyawe mu maraso,Indimi z'imbwa zawe zigabane abanzi bawe.”

25.text: Mana, barebye amagenda yawe,Amagenda y'Imana yanjye,Ni yo Mwami wanjye yinjira ahera.

26.text: Abaririmbyi bagiye imbere,Abacuranzi bakurikiyeho,Hagati y'abakobwa bavuza amashako.

27.text: Muhimbarize Imana mu materaniro,Mwa bakomotse ku isōko ya Isirayeli mwe,Muhimbaze Umwami Imana.

28.text: Nguriya umuryango wa Benyamini umuhererezi,Ni wo mutware wabo,Harimo n'abakomeye b'Abayuda n'umutwe wabo,N'abakomeye b'Abazebuluni,N'abakomeye b'Abanafutali.

29.text: Imana yawe igutegekeye imbaraga,Mana, komeza ibyo wadukoreye,

30.text: Uri mu rusengero rwawe,I Yerusalemu ni ho abami bazakuzanira amaturo.

31.text: Hana ya nyamaswa yo mu rufunzo,N'amapfizi menshi n'inyana zo mu mahanga,Kugira ngo bakuramye bazanye ibice by'ifeza,Tatanya amahanga yishimira intambara.

32.text: Abakomeye bazaza bavuye muri Egiputa,Etiyopiya hazihuta kuramburira Imana amaboko yaho.

33.text: Mwa bihugu by'abami bo mu isi mwe,Muririmbire Imana,Muririmbire Umwami ishimwe.Sela.

34.text: Ni we ugenda ku ijuru ryo hejuru y'amajuru yose,Ryahozeho na kera kose,Dore avuga ijwi, ijwi rikomeye.

35.text: Mwāturire Imana ko ifite imbaraga,Ubwiza bwayo buri hejuru y'Abisirayeli,Imbaraga zayo ziri mu bicu.

36.text: Mana, uteye ubwoba uri ahera hawe,Imana y'Abisirayeli ni yo iha abantu bayo imbaraga no gukomera.Imana ihimbazwe.
